protocol.hypothesis: Explicit requests naming multiple complete code symbols need coverage of each symbol. Protect already represented named facts at their original ranks and use only other trailing slots for missing complete matches.
protocol.eligibility: Two to four distinct compound identifiers in at most five whitespace words, at most one contextual word, existing collection/numeric/wildcard guards, no files/failure or exact incumbent title. Full pools only; preserve first result. Require every requested name to have an eligible existing or planned match; otherwise no change. Abort if insufficient unprotected slots.
protocol.selection: Development and unchanged unit contracts before exposed reserved split; reject individual fact/rank losses, negative ID/order changes, scope/trust/tag violations and budget overruns.

extra_guard.description: Protect exact incumbent titles named by individual request terms, including the non-compound context term; a unit regression reproduced displacement before this guard.

decision: Ship atomic coverage of explicitly named compound symbols, preserving existing named and literal-title facts at their ranks. Eight existing complete answers gained; no new cases.
limitations: Exposed correlated source incidents; focused code-name coverage, not independent semantic generalization or live-agent success. No inference or vector/model change; additional indexed FTS scans only.
